Lemma
[The differential of an open-submanifold inclusion]

Let $M$ be a smooth manifold and $U\subseteq M$ open. Under the canonical identification $T_xU=T_xM$, the inclusion $\iota \colon U\hookrightarrow M$ satisfies \[ d\iota _x=\operatorname {id}\colon T_xU\longrightarrow T_xM. \] In particular, $d\iota _x$ is an isomorphism.

Proof

\sketch A chart for $U$ is the restriction of a chart for $M$, so the coordinate representation of $\iota $ is the identity. Its differential is therefore the identity.

□
